# Snapfeed

> A swipeable, AI-summarized feed of African and world news, sports, geopolitics, tech and culture, refreshed every 30 minutes from 30+ verified sources. Every story is aggregated from a verified source, AI-summarized, and
> published with an attribution link to the original reporting.

Snapfeed covers: News (110), Sports (102), Culture (97), Entertainment (63), Tech (34), Web3 (22), Geopolitics (18), Education (16), AI & Quantum (14), IoT & Open Source (12).

## Citing us
Quoting our summaries is welcome with a link to the canonical
https://snaps.ugaplex.com/post/<id> URL. Original reporting always lives at the source
linked on each post page — cite them for primary facts.

## Content for retrieval
- [Full text for LLMs](https://snaps.ugaplex.com/llms-full.txt): titles, categories and
  summaries of the 60 most recent posts
- [RSS feed](https://snaps.ugaplex.com/feed.xml): latest 50 posts with summaries
- [Sitemap](https://snaps.ugaplex.com/sitemap.xml): all post URLs
- [Frontend](https://snaps.ugaplex.com): swipeable PWA

## Update cadence
Sources are scraped every 30 minutes; Snapfeed reflects the newest
~100 posts at any time.
